e815b5b085.q: What are the key interface adaptations Apple made to macOS for the new ProLED XDR MacBook Pro touchscreen?
e815b5b085.a: Apple adapted Mac OS for touch targets by focusing on key elements like buttons, stepwise controllers with up and down arrow buttons positioned above and below the finger, sliders with quality touch targets, and radial dials that expand their touch angle radius when touched. The operating system gets out of the way as the touch target appears, and there is an accessibility setting to turn off the touchscreen entirely if needed.
